notes.title: On The Bubble Full Release
notes.content:
Finally we have a full release for On the Bubble!!

We have added the level editor and a few tweaks to the UI. It's time to create your levels and share them with the community. TIME TO BALL!!!

notes.title: Pre-Release Update
notes.content:
Changes

Remastered all Campaign levels
New Sounds and Music
Added and improved VFX
Main Menu revamped


Additions

2 new Campaign levels
Leaderboards
New Skyboxes
 

Fixes

Camera clipping
Physics improvements
Timer starts when you move
Visual and Performance improvements
 

Planned Updates
Level Editor (1.0 release)

notes.title: On the Bubble now in Early Access
notes.content:
Known Issues

 The ball clips through the half-pipe ramps sometimes.
 The ball sometimes collides with the edges of the platforms and jumps up
 The timer keeps counting when you restart from the pause menu, (Quick restart works as intended)
 Camera clips into environment when you pass under geometry.


Planned updates

 End of level screen with Leaderboards
 Loading screens
 UI updates
 More levels 
 Level Editor (this will come in the next big update)
